title: Enforce soft and hard spend limits on graph runs
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `run_budgeted_graph` with soft then hard policies on a two-node compute graph. Soft wind-down returns soft_exhausted; hard fail returns hard_budget_exceeded. Related: `fangore_insp_budget_subgraph_rollup`. [^insp-budget]
implementation: `BudgetPolicy` soft/hard limits on `GraphExecutor`. Product verb `run_budgeted_graph`; hosts also pass `budget_policy=` on `run_recipe` / story `environment.budget`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `soft_and_hard.yaml` drives `run_budgeted_graph`; expects soft_status / hard_status and error codes.
